title: Microsoft Purview: sensitivity label inheritance for Teams meeting artifacts (Worldwide)
summary: The briefing's rollout facts, inheritance behavior, encryption restrictions and MP4 command are supported. The automatic path warning is resolved by the cited label-policy creation instructions; only a missing navigation heading and a checklist/table coverage mismatch need minor corrections.

claims.claim: Teams recordings, transcripts and Loop notes can be configured to inherit their meeting's sensitivity label automatically without manual labeling.
claims.quote: Teams meeting artifacts, including recordings, transcripts, and Loop notes, can now be configured to automatically inherit the sensitivity label from the meeting.

claims.claim: The Purview portal path is Solutions > Information Protection > Publishing policies > Publish label > Apply meeting label to artifacts.
claims.quote: Solutions > Information Protection > Publishing policies. ... On the Label policies page, select Publish label to start the Create policy configuration. Meetings page: Configure label policy settings ... Apply meeting label to artifacts
claims.fix: Add the omitted Label policies page heading: 'Solutions > Information Protection > Publishing policies > Label policies > Publish label > Apply meeting label to artifacts'. The creation route is at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-sensitivity-labels#publish-sensitivity-labels-by-creating-a-label-policy; the existing controls[0].ui.docs page supplies the setting itself and should remain. Both pages were read and are already cited.

claims.claim: Recordings and transcripts with an encrypting label cannot be downloaded.

claims.claim: Sensitivity labels encrypting MP4 files must use Assign permissions now.
claims.quote: Sensitivity labels that apply encryption must be configured with the Assign permissions now option, rather than user-defined permissions.

claims.quote: Sensitivity labels that apply encryption must be configured with the Assign permissions now option, rather than user-defined permissions.

claims.claim: Changing an encrypting sensitivity label requires appropriate permissions.

claims.claim: Policy priority decides which setting wins when multiple label policies conflict for a user.
claims.quote: If there's a conflict in settings from multiple policies, the settings from the policy with the highest priority (highest order number) is applied. In other words, the highest priority wins for each setting.

claims.claim: Set-LabelPolicy documents a mandatory-label setting for meetings.
claims.quote: TeamworkMandatory: Outlook and Teams apps that support this setting can enable or disable mandatory labeling for meetings.

claims.claim: Set-LabelPolicy documents a default-label setting for meetings.
claims.quote: teamworkdefaultlabelid: Outlook and Teams apps that support this setting apply a default label, or no label for meetings.

claims.claim: Channel meetings inherit the meeting label associated with the channel's container label rather than a label chosen by the organizer.
claims.quote: the sensitivity label must be associated with a container label for the channel. Then, all channel meetings and chats inherit the associated label, which can't be changed by users.
